convertibility_reason: No custom indicators, no external .mqh libraries for trading logic (only standard Trade/SymbolInfo.mqh), simple time-based entry with market orders, fixed lot sizing, no complex money management. All logic is straightforward time-gated buy with position checks.

other_exits: Time-based close: all open positions for _Symbol are closed when ServerTime >= TimeClose (default 23:30)

custom_logic_notes: This EA is a time-gated market buy executor. It opens a BUY order at market price (ask) only during a narrow time window (TimeStart to TimeEnd, default 01:30-01:35) if: (1) the server time is within the symbol's trading session, (2) daily deal count for the symbol < DailyNumPositions, (3) no open positions exist for the symbol. SL and TP are passed as NULL (no stop loss or take profit). All positions are forcibly closed when ServerTime >= TimeClose (default 23:30). The NumberDeals function counts all non-zero-profit deals (both winning and losing) from today's history. The EA runs on a 1-second timer (OnTimer), not OnTick. There is no short/sell logic — only buy orders. The BuyOrder function's log messages incorrectly say 'Sell()' but actually execute Buy().
python_conversion_notes: Simple time-based buy EA with no indicators. Key conversion points: (1) Replace OnTimer with a scheduled check or polling loop at 1-second intervals. (2) Map SymbolInfoSessionTrade to broker-specific session schedules or hardcode index trading hours. (3) The daily deal counter (NumberDeals) needs equivalent history querying. (4) No SL/TP simplifies order placement — just market buy at ask. (5) TimeClose force-close all positions is a simple loop. (6) LotCheck normalizes volume to broker step/min/max. (7) CheckMoneyForTrade verifies free margin before entry. (8) CTrade.SetTypeFillingBySymbol must map to broker's fill policy. (9) Note: the BuyOrder function logs 'Sell()' messages — this is a bug in the original, not logic-affecting.
